description: This file contains Bash functions and constants for manipulating IPv4 addresses, including conversion between string and numeric forms, address validation, prefix and mask calculations, and network range checks. It is likely part of a network configuration or utility script within a larger project, specifically related to IPv4 address handling.

methods.name: assert_uint32
methods.description: Validates that the input is a decimal integer within the 32-bit unsigned integer range.

methods.name: bitcount
methods.description: Counts the number of bits set to 1 in the provided 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: str2ip
methods.description: Converts a dotted quad IP address string into its 32-bit integer representation.

methods.name: ip2str
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit integer IP address into its dotted quad string representation.

methods.name: prefix2netmask
methods.description: Converts a CIDR prefix length into a 32-bit subnet mask.

methods.name: is_contiguous
methods.description: Checks if a given netmask has contiguous bits (valid netmask format).

methods.name: netmask2prefix
methods.description: Converts a netmask into a CIDR prefix length after validating its contiguousness.

methods.name: is_rfc1918
methods.description: Checks if an IP address belongs to the private RFC1918 address ranges.

methods.name: is_rfc3927
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is within the link-local RFC3927 range.

methods.name: is_loopback
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is a loopback address.

methods.name: is_multicast
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is a multicast address.
